findings.description: Original owner states members consented to admin edits but same line expressly says direct consent records were not independently checked; never represent blanket consent as verified or weaken RLS. Coordinate #96 only.

October21 universal backend/SQL/Edge consent applies only to each explicitly approved bounded release, not automatically to future deployments; newer #417/#457 require explicit owner-selected READY release.
Repeat preservation of private GitHub Free conflicts with current public metadata. This is same existing finding S2-161-PUBLIC, not a new independent vulnerability count.
